description.value: Field House Brewing Co. is a community-rooted craft brewery that opened its Chilliwack tasting room in 2020 at the District 1881 development in downtown Chilliwack. The rotating tap list spans crushable ales, experimental IPAs, and barrel-aged sours, complemented by a farm-to-table canteen program using fresh local ingredients. Cyclists passing through will find a laid-back atmosphere with regular live music nights and community programming.

address.value: 9251 Woolly Dog Alley #102, Chilliwack, BC V2P 0J6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places this as the Chilliwack tasting room of Field House Brewing Co., corroborated by the website listing two locations with the Chilliwack address at Woolly Dog Alley. The website confirms an active food-and-drink operation with farm-to-table canteen menus at both locations; the CHWK menu page explicitly marks vegetarian and gluten-aware items. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
concerns: Address discrepancy within the website itself: contact page lists '9251 Woolly Dog Alley #102' while the site-wide footer lists '251 Woolly Dog Alley #102' — the leading '9' may be a typo; should be verified.
OSM record carried no address; address was sourced entirely from the website's contact page.
OSM name is 'Field House Tasting Room' but the business presents itself as 'Field House Brewing Co.' / 'Field House CHWK' on its website — minor name mismatch.
Phone number (+1-604-776-2739) is from OSM only; the website does not publish a phone number, so it cannot be confirmed or denied.

Field House operates two distinct physical locations (Abbotsford and Chilliwack); this OSM record's coordinates align with Chilliwack, but a separate OSM record may exist or should exist for the Abbotsford location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active craft brewery tasting room in downtown Chilliwack with food service, community programming, and a strong local identity — a legitimate and appealing stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: CHWK menu page lists vegetarian (ⓥ) and gluten-aware (Ⓖ) markers on menu items
